new_claim.statement: For the exact carrier decomposition (A0+S)P=ML+Z with M^T Z=0 and g=s_min(M), if L has an r-dimensional right strong subspace E at threshold alpha and Z has an s-dimensional right strong subspace F at threshold beta, r+s=5, and c=||P_E P_F||<1, then s_5((A0+S)P)^2 is at least (a^2+b^2-sqrt((a^2-b^2)^2+4a^2b^2 c^2))/2 with a=g alpha and b=beta. Small signed spectrum of operator norm h and local carrier tail delta cost h+delta by Weyl.
new_claim.continuity_scope: Only the final D5 receiver branch gives a continuous C0 density; unrestricted continuity remains open.

partner_result_applied.application: In the explicit family K_rel=-P_F has symmetric eigenvalues 0,0,0,-1,-1, so the partner theorem at j=3 gives the actual inequality s_3>=2; the new principal-angle fusion with the two transverse modes upgrades this to s_5>=min(2,|t|).
